conclusion: No currently reproducible inspected official bulk/reference route was verified to jointly expose deterministic security identity and source-native CSI Industry Classification fields.
evidence_notes: CSI classification standard exposes coded hierarchy but no security rows.
CSI300 factsheet exposes security codes and industry names only for top constituents, not full bulk rows.
CSI300 methodology names CSI data-service platform and website as official dissemination channels but does not itself expose a row-level classification schema.
Official 000300 constituent XLS route is a concrete bulk candidate, but the audit transport could not inspect its XLS response schema; it therefore cannot be promoted to PASS.
No concrete public CSI data-service endpoint with the required joint schema was verified.
